title: Does DJ Khaled Want To Collaborate With Pop Icon Britney Spears? "Of Course, I Would; I am Ready"
htmlContent:
DJ Khaled is already looking forward to his next great collaboration.

He just released his new album God Did, the hip-hop mogul revealed that Britney Spears is on his short list of collaborators.

In a interview with "Extra" at Sunday's VMAs, he was asked if he would ever collaborate with the pop superstar, who just worked with Elton John on "Hold Me Closer."

"I would collaborate with anyone that’s representing the love of the music. Collaborating is a beautiful thing. It is important that we come together and make great songs," Khaled said.

He added, “To answer your question, of course I would, I am ready!”

Last week, Khaled dropped his 13 album of his career which featured Drake, Eminem, Kanye West, Lil Wayne, Future, SZA, and JAY-Z.

“I played JAY-Z my album,” Khaled shared. “He said it was my best album, and I was blessed for him to get on a record that I produced, called ‘God Did.'”

As for Britany Spears, she recently deactivated her Instagram.

I’m learning every day is a clean slate to try and be a better person and do what makes me happy … yes, I choose happiness today,” she tweeted. “I tell myself every day to let go of the hurt bitterness and try to forgive myself and others to what may have been hurtful.”

I pray there actually is truth to the Holy Spirit and I hope that spirit is with my children as well !!!” she concluded, referencing her sons, Sean Preston, 16, and Jayden James, 15. “Yes … I choose happiness and joy today
